decisions.reason: The green level-4 bullet color is separate from the theme-color palette; the message's missing-theme-colors observation is already represented as execution evidence and does not change the palette requirement.
Changing the visual color of the level-4 bullet does not change Tab input, nested-list hierarchy, or alignment behavior.
The bullet-color decision does not change named-style typography; the separate caption-typography clause from the same message already has its own MODIFY.
A green level-4 bullet does not alter double-digit numbered-list alignment.
The bullet-color specification does not change the required layout or style stability of legacy copy-paste workflows.
The level-4 bullet color has no necessary effect on pasted-table containment or column-layout stability.
The bullet-color decision does not change the language used for style names or other interface text.
The source's caption typography and bullet-color clauses do not change whether interactive-field help labels are required.
The green level-4 bullet specification does not affect the document's default Word language configuration.
